chunks: And all praise to God, the Lord of all the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Rabb al-Alamin' in Shia supplications?
ai.summary: This verse, serving as the concluding doxology of Surah Al-Saff, echoes the opening praise of Al-Fatiha to create a structural symmetry that emphasizes the completeness of divine worship. In Shia scholarly tradition, it reinforces the concept of Tawhid by affirming Allah’s role as the sole Sustainer (Rabb) of all realms, linking the specific act of standing in ranks for battle to the universal order of creation.
